updates.title: CVE-2026-83711: Azure AD B2C Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: A critical authorization bypass vulnerability in Azure Active Directory B2C allows attackers to escalate privileges by manipulating user-controlled keys. Admins must apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation in identity systems.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70352: Azure AI Language Authentication Bypass
updates.summary: Missing authentication controls in Azure AI Language enable unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network without valid credentials. Organizations using Azure AI Language services should prioritize patching to secure their identity and access controls.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70178: Microsoft Fabric Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization checks in Microsoft Fabric allow authenticated users to escalate their privileges within the service. Admins should review and patch Fabric deployments to ensure proper access controls are enforced.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services: Enhanced sAMAccountName Synchronization
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute, improving hybrid identity consistency. This feature is in public preview and automatically enabled for new managed domains, helping organizations maintain better compatibility with on-premises systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: RMS Connector Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, enhancing security posture. Admins will configure their own Microsoft Entra app registrations and certificates via PowerShell, eliminating reliance on provisioned service principals.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Administrators can now create Data Loss Prevention policies with granular control over classification and text extraction failure scenarios—such as timeouts and throttling—rather than applying a blanket policy. This public preview feature enables more precise incident response and protection strategies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard lets admins track Mean Time to Acknowledge (MTTA), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) metrics for DLP alerts with custom SLA thresholds. Security teams can now monitor operational performance and identify trending sensitive information exposure patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard provides visibility into device health across all endpoints to ensure readiness for policy updates and quickly identify systems unable to receive DLP policies. This helps admins maintain operational readiness and rapidly troubleshoot deployment issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is expanding auto-labeling capabilities to support larger SharePoint scopes and improving policy management flexibility with richer visibility into labeling activity. These improvements enable enterprises to scale information classification at higher volumes and better validate policy effectiveness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now coming to macOS, providing parity with Windows capabilities except for advanced label-based protection features. This expansion enables macOS users to apply and view sensitivity labels consistently across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Organizations can now import PST files directly from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using the Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and execution phases. This streamlines PST migration workflows and leverages cloud-native storage instead of requiring traditional file transfers.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Auto-Expanding Archive Beyond 1.5TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5TB limit, enabling continuous archive growth without operational interruption. This capability is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses and ensures uninterrupted retention at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: Admins can now export information protection scanner data stored in SQL tables to create custom reports on labeling, classification, and protection actions across scanned repositories. This enables organizations to build tailored compliance and monitoring dashboards aligned with their governance needs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365 locations. This extends DLP governance beyond the Microsoft ecosystem to multicloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode before enforcement to preview which items would be labeled without making actual changes. This preview capability allows administrators to validate policy accuracy and review match results before rolling out production enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Policy Performance Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: A new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details displays at-a-glance performance metrics that vary based on simulation or enforcement mode. This visibility helps admins understand how policies identify and label content, supporting data-driven policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Sensitivity label policies now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365 locations. This enables consistent information classification across hybrid and multicloud environments.
